description: This PHP source file defines constants, functions, and a helper class related to VAST video ad banners, including video URL parsing, configuration retrieval, and message display.

classes.name: VideoAdsHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to generate warning/error messages and help links related to video ads.

methods.name: getVastVideoTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of supported video MIME types, optionally excluding 'video/x-flv' based on input.

methods.name: encodeUserSuppliedData
methods.description: Encodes user input data for HTML output using htmlspecialchars.

methods.name: xmlspecialchars
methods.description: Encodes text for XML/HTML output using htmlspecialchars.

methods.name: combineVideoUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete video URL based on provided admin fields, handling streaming and progressive delivery types.

methods.name: parseVideoUrl
methods.description: Parses a video URL to extract connection URL and filename, setting delivery mode accordingly.

methods.name: appendClientMessage
methods.description: Adds a debug message to the client messages array, optionally dumping a variable.

methods.name: getClientMessages
methods.description: Retrieves accumulated client debug messages, formatted as HTML comments if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: getVideoPlayerSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a video player configuration setting by parameter ID.

methods.name: getVideoOverlaySetting
methods.description: Retrieves a video overlay configuration setting by parameter ID.
